start.title: A Flag in the Drift
start.text: Through the whiteout, a strip of dark cloth jerks above the snow. It is a patrol pennant tied to a broken spear. Around it, the drift is churned by knees, hands, and at least one body being dragged.

buckets.flavourText: The drag marks lead downslope, but one set of prints breaks away toward a stand of firs. Someone separated from the group alive.
You can follow the drag trail confidently, but the storm has erased anything finer.
The marks are collapsing under fresh snow even while you look at them.

choices.text: Take the pennant back and do not follow

split.title: Two Trails
split.text: The firs are closer; the drag trail is clearer. You may have time to investigate one before the storm erases the other.

survivor.title: Under the Fir Boughs
survivor.text: A young patrol scout lies wedged beneath low branches, one boot missing and both hands wrapped inside his coat. He is awake but confused.

buckets.flavourText: You warm his feet, orient him, and keep him walking without letting him rush.
He can walk, but only with your arm around him.
He tries to stand, collapses, and begins shivering violently.

carry.title: Dead Weight in a Storm
carry.text: He cannot walk. Carrying him through knee-deep snow will be brutal.

buckets.flavourText: You reach the road exhausted but with the scout still conscious.
You make the road in stages, stopping whenever your legs begin to shake.
After a dozen steps you know you will both be stranded if you continue.

shelter_here.title: Shelter in Place
shelter_here.text: You pack snow against the firs as a windbreak and share what warmth you can until the squall eases. It is slow, miserable work, but he is still talking when visibility returns.

escort.title: One Returned
escort.text: The first patrolman at the gate recognizes him before you can speak. Questions begin immediately: where are the others, what happened, who did you see? You have few answers, but one person came back alive.

drag.title: What Was Dragged
drag.text: The trail ends at a shallow gully where a dead patrolman lies beneath a cloak. His companions moved him here to keep him from being lost under the open road, then continued without him. A satchel is tucked under his shoulder.

choices.text: Bring the satchel and identification back
Leave the body undisturbed and mark the gully

return_dead.title: A Name Returned
return_dead.text: You take only what identifies him. The storm begins covering the gully again before you reach the road.

mark.title: A Place to Find Again
mark.text: You stack three dark stones where the gully meets the road and leave the dead with his cloak closed.

pennant.title: A Warning Brought Home
pennant.text: You take the broken pennant and turn back. Whatever happened to the patrol is still out there, but at least the hub will know where to start looking.
